checks_run.procedure: Confirm the assignment's operating-logic list through the integration and acceptance suites, my API probes and my in-process probe. Judge QA-C O-2 and QA-B's 409-vs-422 observation against the sources. Read the notes and acceptance texts of the 137 DG4 register rows and judge every partial-coverage disclosure.
checks_run.command: integration run as DOM-R7-03; dom-api as DOM-R7-04; python3 read of requirements.csv (137 DG4 rows; notes matching partial|deferred|residual|DG5-DG7); git diff 1e0dc5d..dab4562 -- docs/delivery/requirements.csv (empty)
checks_run.expected: The rules match their sources, and the observations and partial disclosures are acceptable.
checks_run.actual:
A01-A14 and the backend suites pass 1994/1994, and the operating logic holds:
- KPI and value logic: RAG comes from the KPI trajectory, never from completion, and a KPI with no trajectory stays Unknown (B0095, M0247). Forecast, submitted, upside and scenario values never count as validated. Finance validation is FIN-only, and an amendment keeps the chain. A non-financial benefit is n/a. Allocations over 100 % and links over 110 % are refused.
- Governance: escalation happens once, to the next authority, counted in working days on the calendar (B0099 SLAs). The blocker rule creates one T16 ask (B0102). Quorum is enforced and published minutes are immutable. There is one corrective case per source.
- Closure and sustainment: closure is refused while value is pending unless a transition decision exists. BAU acceptance is by the receiver only and creates the reviews once. Areas, actuals and the CI backlog continue after closure, and reopening keeps the originals.
- Gates and change control: G5 requires risk closure and the scale scope, and G6 requires ownership transfer. Waivers carry an expiry and a compensating action. The Modular G3 waiver (D-110, ADR-0021 W1-W7) covers missing links only and is refused when revoked or expired. Change requests keep the originals.
QA-C O-2 is acceptable. The playbook defines phases and gates (B0010-B0016), not a record lifecycle. The explicit draft->active transition approved at DG1 is the activation, and the UI shows phase and record status separately ('Draft – not submitted' next to 'Phase: Diagnose').
QA-B's 409 when approving a Draft gate is the DG2-approved state-conflict contract. REQ-S04-010 requires only a refusal, so the code is not a source deviation.
The register is unchanged since round 6, and its 137 rows are IMPLEMENTED. The partial disclosures are honest and acceptable: PB-065, PB-066, S04-014 and S07-015 (API and stubbed-web proof only, D-114; the server clock cannot be injected), S15-008, S20-011 (no root A11 e2e; covered by the frontend specs), and S12-009/010/011/014/016 (administrator configurability is verified at DG5 under REQ-S12-001/002). REQ-S16-005's acceptance (A13) passes, and its production idle-load defect F-DG4-128 is now repaired (DOM-R7-10).
